qemu-system-x86_64 -machine q35,kernel-irqchip=split -device intel-iommu,intremap=on,caching-mode=on -m 6G -smp 4 -accel tcg,thread=multi,tb-size=1024 -cpu max -drive if=pflash,format=raw,unit=0,readonly=on,file=qemu-11.1.1/share/qemu/edk2-x86_64-code.fd -drive if=pflash,format=raw,unit=1,file=target/qemu/OVMF_VARS.fd -drive format=raw,file=fat:rw:target/qemu/esp -drive file=target/qemu/data.img,if=none,id=vd0,format=raw -device virtio-blk-pci,disable-legacy=on,iommu_platform=on,drive=vd0 -device virtio-vga,disable-legacy=on,iommu_platform=on,vectors=0,edid=on,xres=1920,yres=1080 -device qemu-xhci,id=xhci -device virtio-rng-pci,disable-legacy=on,iommu_platform=on -device virtio-net-pci,disable-legacy=on,iommu_platform=on,netdev=net0 -netdev user,id=net0 -chardev socket,id=chrtpm,path=target/qemu/swtpm/swtpm-sock -tpmdev emulator,id=tpm0,chardev=chrtpm -device tpm-crb,tpmdev=tpm0 -audiodev none,id=snd0 -device intel-hda -device hda-duplex,audiodev=snd0 -qmp unix:target/qemu/qmp.sock,server,nowait -object filter-dump,id=egress0,netdev=net0,queue=rx,file=target/capture/main.pcap -object filter-dump,id=ingress0,netdev=net0,queue=tx,file=target/capture/main-in.pcap -serial file:target/qemu/serial.log -display none -no-reboot
